searchText: <@&911292790653194300> I think the goerli relayer is down now. Last sucessful header was 2 hours ago Thanks for the heads-up, it's currently producing blocks. Seems there was a beacon node cluster sync issue, responsible for the gap between slots 377334 and 3777605. What's the infra behind a relayer? Is it dependant on a single beacon node being synced? our relay supports connection to multiple beacon nodes: https://github.com/flashbots/mev-boost-relay/blob/main/cmd/api.go#L37 I see so Prater is running with only one now but mainnet will have many? We use beacon node clusters everywhere. Can still run into sync or other issues, in particular in testnets where we work on the services and infrastructure frequently.
